# Data Source: stripe_invoice_line

A line of an invoice. Look one up by the `invoice` and the line's `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_invoice" "monthly" {
  id = "in_123"
}

data "stripe_invoice_line" "first" {
  invoice = data.stripe_invoice.monthly.id
  id      = data.stripe_invoice.monthly.lines.data[0].id
}

output "line_amount" {
  value = data.stripe_invoice_line.first.amount
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `invoice` - (Required) The ID of the parent object.
* `id` - (Required) The ID of the invoice line to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `amount` - The amount, in cents (or local equivalent).
* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `description` - An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.
* `discount_amounts` - The amount of discount calculated per discount for this line item. See [`discount_amounts`](#discount_amounts) below.
* `discountable` - If true, discounts will apply to this line item. Always false for prorations.
* `discounts` - The discounts applied to the invoice line item. Line item discounts are applied before invoice discounts. Use `expand[]=discounts` to expand each discount.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `metadata` - Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Note that for line items with `type=subscription`, `metadata` reflects the current metadata from the subscription associated with the line item, unless the invoice line was directly updated with different metadata after creation.
* `parent` - The parent that generated this line item. See [`parent`](#parent) below.
* `period` - See [`period`](#period) below.
* `pretax_credit_amounts` - Contains pretax credit amounts (ex: discount, credit grants, etc) that apply to this line item. See [`pretax_credit_amounts`](#pretax_credit_amounts) below.
* `pricing` - The pricing information of the line item. See [`pricing`](#pricing) below.
* `quantity` - Quantity of units for the invoice line item in integer format, with any decimal precision truncated. For the line item's full-precision decimal quantity, use `quantity_decimal`. This field will be deprecated in favor of `quantity_decimal` in a future version. If the line item is a proration or subscription, the quantity of the subscription that the proration was computed for.
* `quantity_decimal` - Non-negative decimal with at most 12 decimal places. The quantity of units for the line item.
* `subscription` -
* `subtotal` - The subtotal of the line item, in cents (or local equivalent), before any discounts or taxes.
* `taxes` - The tax information of the line item. See [`taxes`](#taxes) below.

<a id="discount_amounts"></a>
### `discount_amounts`

The `discount_amounts` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `amount` - The amount, in cents (or local equivalent), of the discount.
* `discount` - The discount that was applied to get this discount amount.

<a id="parent"></a>
### `parent`

The `parent` attribute supports:

* `invoice_item_details` - Details about the invoice item that generated this line item See [`parent.invoice_item_details`](#parent.invoice_item_details) below.
* `subscription_item_details` - Details about the subscription item that generated this line item See [`parent.subscription_item_details`](#parent.subscription_item_details) below.
* `type` - The type of parent that generated this line item Possible values: `invoice_item_details`, `subscription_item_details`.

<a id="parent.invoice_item_details"></a>
### `parent.invoice_item_details`

The `parent.invoice_item_details` attribute supports:

* `invoice_item` - The invoice item that generated this line item
* `proration` - Whether this is a proration
* `proration_details` - Additional details for proration line items See [`parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details`](#parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details) below.
* `subscription` - The subscription that the invoice item belongs to

<a id="parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details"></a>
### `parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details`

The `parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details` attribute supports:

* `credited_items` - For a credit proration `line_item`, the original debit line_items to which the credit proration applies. See [`parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details.credited_items`](#parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details.credited_items) below.

<a id="parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details.credited_items"></a>
### `parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details.credited_items`

The `parent.invoice_item_details.proration_details.credited_items` attribute supports:

* `invoice` - Invoice containing the credited invoice line items
* `invoice_line_items` - Credited invoice line items

<a id="parent.subscription_item_details"></a>
### `parent.subscription_item_details`

The `parent.subscription_item_details` attribute supports:

* `invoice_item` - The invoice item that generated this line item
* `proration` - Whether this is a proration
* `proration_details` - Additional details for proration line items See [`parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details`](#parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details) below.
* `subscription` - The subscription that the subscription item belongs to
* `subscription_item` - The subscription item that generated this line item

<a id="parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details"></a>
### `parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details`

The `parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details` attribute supports:

* `credited_items` - For a credit proration `line_item`, the original debit line_items to which the credit proration applies. See [`parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details.credited_items`](#parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details.credited_items) below.

<a id="parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details.credited_items"></a>
### `parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details.credited_items`

The `parent.subscription_item_details.proration_details.credited_items` attribute supports:

* `invoice` - Invoice containing the credited invoice line items
* `invoice_line_items` - Credited invoice line items

<a id="period"></a>
### `period`

The `period` attribute supports:

* `end` - The end of the period, which must be greater than or equal to the start. This value is inclusive.
* `start` - The start of the period. This value is inclusive.

<a id="pretax_credit_amounts"></a>
### `pretax_credit_amounts`

The `pretax_credit_amounts` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `amount` - The amount, in cents (or local equivalent), of the pretax credit amount.
* `credit_balance_transaction` - The credit balance transaction that was applied to get this pretax credit amount.
* `discount` - The discount that was applied to get this pretax credit amount.
* `type` - Type of the pretax credit amount referenced. Possible values: `credit_balance_transaction`, `discount`.

<a id="pricing"></a>
### `pricing`

The `pricing` attribute supports:

* `price_details` - See [`pricing.price_details`](#pricing.price_details) below.
* `type` - The type of the pricing details. Possible values: `price_details`.
* `unit_amount_decimal` - The unit amount (in the `currency` specified) of the item which contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.

<a id="pricing.price_details"></a>
### `pricing.price_details`

The `pricing.price_details` attribute supports:

* `price` - The ID of the price this item is associated with.
* `product` - The ID of the product this item is associated with.

<a id="taxes"></a>
### `taxes`

The `taxes` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `amount` - The amount of the tax, in cents (or local equivalent).
* `tax_behavior` - Whether this tax is inclusive or exclusive. Possible values: `exclusive`, `inclusive`.
* `tax_rate_details` - Additional details about the tax rate. Only present when `type` is `tax_rate_details`. See [`taxes.tax_rate_details`](#taxes.tax_rate_details) below.
* `taxability_reason` - The reasoning behind this tax, for example, if the product is tax exempt. The possible values for this field may be extended as new tax rules are supported. Possible values: `customer_exempt`, `not_available`, `not_collecting`, `not_subject_to_tax`, `not_supported`, `portion_product_exempt`, `portion_reduced_rated`, `portion_standard_rated`, `product_exempt`, `product_exempt_holiday`, `proportionally_rated`, `reduced_rated`, `reverse_charge`, `standard_rated`, `taxable_basis_reduced`, `zero_rated`.
* `taxable_amount` - The amount on which tax is calculated, in cents (or local equivalent).
* `type` - The type of tax information. Possible values: `tax_rate_details`.

<a id="taxes.tax_rate_details"></a>
### `taxes.tax_rate_details`

The `taxes.tax_rate_details` attribute supports:

* `tax_rate` - ID of the tax rate
